title: [PLACEHOLDER] Intended Purpose and Domain Scope
description: Clarity of the AI asset's operational domain, target users, and explicit boundary of intended use.

rubricJson.0: No documented domain scope or intended purpose.
rubricJson.1: Informal description exists, but scope boundaries are ambiguous.
rubricJson.2: Documented purpose and domain scope approved by the asset owner.
rubricJson.3: Scope, exclusions, and target user groups are formally documented and reviewed.
rubricJson.4: Scope is continuously validated against actual deployment telemetry and business outcomes.

title: [PLACEHOLDER] Business Outcome Alignment
description: Traceability between the AI capability and a defined enterprise or business unit objective.

rubricJson.0: No stated business objective or value hypothesis.
rubricJson.1: General efficiency claim without measurable target.
rubricJson.2: Defined business objective linked to business unit priorities.
rubricJson.3: Quantified target outcomes agreed with finance and business sponsors.
rubricJson.4: Ongoing benefit realisation tracked against strategic KPIs with board visibility.

title: [PLACEHOLDER] Data and Jurisdictional Suitability
description: Fitness of training, grounding, and operational data for the jurisdictions and sensitivity tiers involved.

rubricJson.0: Data sources and jurisdictional constraints are unknown.
rubricJson.1: Data sensitivity identified informally without formal sign-off.
rubricJson.2: Data classification and applicable jurisdictions are documented.
rubricJson.3: Data lineage, residency, and privacy controls verified prior to pilot.
rubricJson.4: Automated data governance checks and periodic jurisdictional compliance reviews in place.

title: [PLACEHOLDER] Accountable Executive Owner
description: A named individual with business accountability for the asset's outcomes, risk posture, and compliance.

rubricJson.1: Technical contact exists, but no business accountability assigned.
rubricJson.2: Named accountable owner recorded in the AI Asset Register.
rubricJson.3: Owner actively reviews risks, metrics, and governance actions on schedule.
rubricJson.4: Accountability embedded in executive performance objectives with succession cover.

title: [PLACEHOLDER] Human Oversight Design
description: Named human overseer(s) with capability, context, and authority to intervene in AI outputs.

rubricJson.1: Ad-hoc user review without formal training or authority.
rubricJson.2: Named overseer assigned with documented intervention procedures.
rubricJson.3: Overseer workload, override authority, and escalation SLA tested.
rubricJson.4: Continuous oversight effectiveness monitoring with override telemetry.

title: [PLACEHOLDER] Escalation Path and Governance Liaison
description: Clear escalation route for incidents, boundary breaches, and ethical or regulatory concerns.

rubricJson.2: Defined escalation path to asset owner and Governance Office.
rubricJson.3: Time-bound SLAs for incident and risk escalation tested via tabletop exercises.
rubricJson.4: Automated alerting integrated with incident response and board reporting.

title: [PLACEHOLDER] Decision-Rights Matrix Completeness
description: Explicit separation of autonomous actions, human-confirmed actions, and out-of-scope actions.

rubricJson.1: Informal understanding of what the AI may or may not do.
rubricJson.2: Decision-rights matrix documented across all three tiers.
rubricJson.3: Matrix version-controlled, signed off by Governance Office, and communicated to operators.
rubricJson.4: Matrix enforced technically via guardrails and verified in regular appraisals.

title: [PLACEHOLDER] Technical Guardrails and Enforcement
description: Technical controls preventing the AI asset from executing out-of-scope or unconfirmed actions.

rubricJson.0: No technical guardrails or permission constraints.
rubricJson.1: Prompt instructions only, with no programmatic enforcement.
rubricJson.2: Role-based API permissions or approval gates implemented for high-risk actions.
rubricJson.3: Deterministic policy checks, rate limits, and kill-switch verified in testing.
rubricJson.4: Real-time boundary telemetry with automatic suspension on critical breach.

title: [PLACEHOLDER] Delegation and Authority Review Cadence
description: Regular review and re-approval of granted decision rights as the asset or environment evolves.

rubricJson.0: Authority never reviewed after initial deployment.
rubricJson.1: Reviewed only after an incident occurs.
rubricJson.2: Annual review of authority rules scheduled.
rubricJson.3: Quarterly or lifecycle-gated authority reviews with documented sign-off.
rubricJson.4: Dynamic authority adjustment tied directly to AAEF appraisal profile.

title: [PLACEHOLDER] Separation of Activity and Outcome Metrics
description: Distinction between usage/volume indicators and genuine business or mission outcomes.

rubricJson.1: Only activity metrics (queries, active users, token volume) tracked.
rubricJson.2: Both activity and outcome metrics defined, though outcome baselines are partial.
rubricJson.3: Clear separation enforced; outcome metrics measured with explicit confidence ratings.
rubricJson.4: Outcome metrics drive investment, retention, and scaling decisions.

title: [PLACEHOLDER] Quality, Accuracy, and Reliability Telemetry
description: Measurement of output accuracy, hallucination or error rates, latency, and drift.

rubricJson.2: Periodic evaluation against a curated test set.
rubricJson.3: Continuous automated quality and drift monitoring with alert thresholds.
rubricJson.4: Closed-loop quality telemetry linked to risk register and incident triggers.

title: [PLACEHOLDER] Cost and Value Traceability
description: Tracking of full TCO (build, licence, compute, governance) alongside realised value.

rubricJson.1: Direct vendor or compute cost tracked only.
rubricJson.2: Full cost categories and planned benefits recorded quarterly.
rubricJson.3: Actual vs planned benefits tracked with measured vs assumed separation.
rubricJson.4: Risk-adjusted ROI and unit economics reviewed by executive committee.

title: [PLACEHOLDER] Performance and Objective Review Cadence
description: Structured periodic evaluation of whether the asset continues to meet its intended objectives.

rubricJson.2: Scheduled periodic review covering performance and adoption.
rubricJson.3: Formal multi-stakeholder evaluation with documented findings and actions.
rubricJson.4: Continuous evaluation integrated with AAEF appraisals and lifecycle gating.

title: [PLACEHOLDER] Governance and Regulatory Compliance Verification
description: Verification against internal policies and external regulatory obligations.

rubricJson.2: Controls mapped to internal standards with periodic evidence checks.
rubricJson.3: Independent control effectiveness testing mapped to external frameworks.
rubricJson.4: Audit-ready continuous compliance posture with zero overdue actions.

title: [PLACEHOLDER] Adoption, Change Management, and Decommissioning Readiness
description: Assessment of workforce adoption, training effectiveness, and criteria for retirement.

rubricJson.1: Basic user communications sent at launch.
rubricJson.2: Adoption tracked alongside user training and support channels.
rubricJson.3: Structured change management and explicit retirement triggers defined.
rubricJson.4: Demonstrated workforce capability uplift and proven decommissioning runbook.
